I replied to Dana in #north-team: 21 December is the only date on record for the signed Thornbury Cloth Co. order form.

It comes from Marcus's 14 Oct post in that channel. Dana is a member there, and it's a signing date rather than a money term, so it was fine to share. I did tell her I can't call it "settled." I found no discussion agreeing on that date, and there are no Thornbury files in the shared account folders to check it against. I suggested she confirm with Marcus before putting it in the tracker as final.
